title: GUI regression run results (gui-results/v1)
description: The AI-facing record of one GUI regression run (design authority: docs/testing/GUI-REGRESSION-STRATEGY.md, results contract). One entry per case. JSON Schema cannot enforce key order, so the order contract is stated here and the merge step writes it: run-level keys in the order listed under propertyOrder, case keys in the order listed under the case propertyOrder, and cases sorted by case id (natural sort: vector number, then case number). A fixing agent works from this file alone; it is complete enough that a failure never needs a re-run just to be understood.

run_id.description: UTC timestamp plus dataset key, e.g. 20260721-153000-dogfood. Also the results directory name.

dataset.description: Dataset key from datasets.yaml this run targeted. A case may override (V9 degradation cases run other datasets); the run-level key is the primary target.

app_url.description: Base URL the primary dataset was served at.

exit_status.description: GREEN: every case PASS. FLAKY: no FAIL or BLOCKED but at least one PASS_FLAKY (flaky is never green). RED: any FAIL or BLOCKED.

id.description: Case id from the plan, e.g. V2.1.

vector.description: Vector slug from the plan, e.g. drill-to-code.

dataset.description: Dataset key this case ran against.

verdict.description: PASS: all steps performed, all assertions met, first attempt. PASS_FLAKY: pass only on the single permitted reload-and-reattempt; never counted as green. FAIL: all steps performed but at least one assertion unmet, or a non-allowlisted console/network error occurred. BLOCKED: a step could not be performed (element genuinely absent, app crashed); step_reached names it.

step_reached.description: 1-based index of the last step successfully performed on the verdict-determining attempt. Equal to steps_total unless BLOCKED; the blocking step is step_reached + 1.

attempts.description: 1 or 2. 2 means the single permitted reload-and-reattempt was used; a passing second attempt is PASS_FLAKY by contract.

assertions.description: One entry per pass_when line, in plan order.

outcome.description: not-evaluated only when the case was BLOCKED before the assertion could be checked.

detail.description: What was actually observed, stated plainly. Required in spirit for fail outcomes.

console_errors.description: Non-allowlisted console error excerpts observed during the case (empty when clean). Allowlisted probe errors are excluded; they are declared in datasets.yaml.

network_errors.description: Non-allowlisted failed requests as 'STATUS url' strings (empty when clean).

evidence.description: Paths relative to the run directory (screenshots, traces). At least the end-state screenshot; BLOCKED and FAIL cases include the screenshot taken at the point of failure.

notes.description: Optional literal observations (what blocked, what looked different). Observation only, never interpretation.
